title: TicketingJunkFeeDefense
description: Schema for sovereign pro se disputes against ticketing monopolies and resale platforms violating statutory fee disclosure mandates (OPEN-TICKET-v1.0).

case_id.description: Unique SHA-256 derived identifier for the ticketing fee dispute.

ticketing_platform.description: Name of target ticketing monopoly or reseller platform.

advertised_base_price_usd.description: Initially displayed base ticket price prior to checkout.

undisclosed_junk_fees_usd.description: Total hidden service, processing, or delivery fees added at checkout.

statutory_violation_count.description: Number of discrete drip pricing or disclosure violations.

statutory_damage_claim_usd.description: Statutory damages claimed under state consumer protection statutes.

estimated_platform_defense_cost_usd.description: Calculated legal defense cost for ticketing platform.

cfaa_compliant.description: Mandatory attestation of zero unauthorized system access.

pro_se_complaint_ready.description: True if complaint and cure notices are compiled on local edge silicon.
